The '''Dorian Club''' was a [[Cantina|bar]]. The [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Sam]] and [[Lauren]] were to rendezvous at the Dorian Club after being forced to separate after stealing the [[Kubaz Insect]] on [[Narigus III]].
